law.catch_line: Restrictions on entity transaction involving a series limited liability company or a foreign series limited liability company

text.section:
A series limited liability company may not:
Convert to a different type of entity;
Domesticate as a foreign limited liability company pursuant to the provisions of Article 14 (§ 13.1-1074 et seq.); or
Except as otherwise provided in § 13.1-1099.16, be a party to or the surviving company of a merger.
A foreign series limited liability company may not domesticate as a Virginia limited liability company pursuant to the provisions of Article 14 (§ 13.1-1074 et seq.).
